acceptanceCriteria: doido-generators/tests/e2e_app_runtime_test.rs (#[ignore], via make example): `doido new blog --database=sqlite` + `doido generate scaffold Post title:string body:text` + cargo build (assert_cmd + tempfile)
Runs the generated app's own binary: db create + db migrate against a temp sqlite, then boots `server` on an ephemeral port
HTTP CRUD via a light client (ureq): POST /posts -> GET /posts (body contains record) -> GET/PATCH/DELETE /posts/:id assert 2xx
Child server torn down; test hermetic (tempdir, no committed state)
make example passes; make verify passes (test is #[ignore]d)
